onWorktreeRemove.stop: Stop any process whose working directory is under the request worktree (dev servers, file watchers, local APIs). Also stop the FDE desk if it was started from a worktree copy of duaer-live.
commands: launchctl kickstart -k "gui/$(id -u)/com.duaer.live8787" 2>/dev/null || (lsof -t -iTCP:8787 -sTCP:LISTEN | xargs kill 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; DUAER_LIVE_NO_BROWSER=1 node bin/duaer-live.mjs --port 8787)

notes: FDE desk is ONLY http://127.0.0.1:8787 (com.duaer.live8787). Never start duaer-live on another port. LaunchAgent sets DUAER_LIVE_NO_BROWSER=1 so kickstart does not open new browser tabs. After merge: remove worktree, then kickstart so routes load from primary checkout on develop.
